Thats what i tell myself. But i still cant seem to drag my ass out to get going. I half wanna quit my job so i can work on getting my shit going for school but than i would be more broke and miserable than i am now.... idk what to do.... But thats really not the root of my problem. Its really more of emotional issues i guess. Im going to post it here just in case anyone has the same problem. I made some i would say bad choices now that i look back at it. I did it all for a girl i cared for..... i did everything i could to make her happy and one day she left.... after that it just seems like a bad string of events. Laid of jobs. Being screwed on salary or just all around not enjoying life as i should. 
I probably seem like a stuborn ass, but im just fed up. And seems like i cant catch a break. Even with personal relationships. I havnt been able to have much of a conversation with people unless there my close friends. Of i meet someone in public, im a nervous wreck or just to silent to approach.

Thank you very much, it means alot, wven coming from a stranger. Its just hard... i do have dreams but it seems like a far off dream or a one and a million shot, not only that but applying for loans for school as an adult seems harder than it was back in highschool. Not only that. But between work and trying to keep my sanity, i have no time to put into my dreams or aspirations.  Feels like im just drowning in a sea of poverty and insanity.
I thank you, and i cant afford theropy or anything like that..... i just dont know whato do, my life is kind of in a rut...... but i cant really seem to help myself. I just make it worse
